reasons: Claimed status is compliant and no redline or comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

Cited paragraphs support the conclusion: p0084 obligates payment only of fees set out in the Fee Schedule for the licence/services taken, p0065 runs maintenance on a renewable one-year term rather than a multi-year committed spend, and p0118 gives Sparkling an unconditional 90-day termination right — no take-or-pay, shortfall charge or volume floor on Customer.

Rationale correctly distinguishes Section 3 licence-scope limits and the p0143 'commitment' hit (no-agency clause) as non-responsive to MINCOMMIT, and correctly notes Vendor-side commitments are not an issue under this rule.

No deterministic check failures; the unmodified paragraphs are consistent with a no-redline compliant classification. Residual (non-blocking) note: the Fee Schedule itself is not in the excerpt, so any minimum spend there would need confirmation.
